chapters.description: Near-white raw canvas, ink type at 17vw, and a single burnt-orange accent. Restraint over spectacle.

nocturne.description: Near-black screen, full-bleed photography, and an acid accent. The page behaves like a film, not a document.

monolith.description: Concrete grey, hard 2px borders, condensed type, and a wireframe 3D monolith spinning behind the hero.
